for i,(act,ep,er) in enumerate(plan):

    res=r if isinstance(r,dict) else {}
    done=res.get('done') or res.get('game_over') or res.get('level_completed')
    p=pos(current_frame,'b'); rd=pos(current_frame,'R')
    print(i,act,"player:",p,"red:",rd,"done:",done)
    if done or p!=ep or rd!=er:
        print("ANOMALY - stopping"); break
